calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900) s
  ON r.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS num_stores,
  COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
  MIN(business_date) AS first_date,
  MAX(business_date) AS last_date,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE store_id < 900
